en.manifest.name: GitHub Comment Bot
en.manifest.description: Answer allowlisted collaborators' @-mention commands in GitHub issue and pull request comments with a read-only agent: questions, comment reviews, status, cancel and help.
en.reply.help:
**Commands** (start a line with the mention; one command per comment):

```
{trigger} ask <question>     answer a question about this issue or pull request
{trigger} review [focus]     review this pull request (comments only)
{trigger} status [task]      show this thread's tasks
{trigger} cancel [task]      cancel the latest or the named task
{trigger} help               show this help
```

Text after the mention without a command is treated as `ask`. Only allowlisted collaborators with write access can use these commands.
en.reply.usage.multiple_commands: This comment contains more than one command. Put each command in its own comment.
en.reply.usage.reserved_verb: `{verb}` is not something this Bot does.
en.reply.usage.too_large: This command is longer than {maxKiB} KiB. Split it into smaller requests.
en.reply.usage.bad_task_ref: A task is named by its 8-character reference, for example `0a1b2c3d`.
en.reply.usage.review_on_issue: `review` works on pull requests. Use `ask` on an issue.
en.reply.notEnabled: `{verb}` is not enabled yet. Use `ask` or `review`.
en.reply.expired: This command is older than {hours} hours, so it was not run. Post it again to run it.
en.reply.cancelNothing: There was nothing to cancel in this thread.
en.reply.status.none: There are no tasks in this thread.
en.tracking.waiting: Task `{ref}`: the answer is ready and waiting to be published.
en.tracking.failed: Task `{ref}`: failed. The details are on the Cognia host.
en.tracking.blocked.pii_blocked: Task `{ref}`: stopped — the request contained personal data that may not be sent to a model.
en.tracking.blocked.readonly_violation: Task `{ref}`: stopped — the agent tried to change files, so nothing was published.
en.tracking.blocked.budget_exceeded: Task `{ref}`: stopped — the cost limit for this task was reached.
en.tracking.blocked.recovery_required: Task `{ref}`: stopped — the agent session was interrupted and needs a look on the Cognia host.
en.tracking.blocked.invalid_result: Task `{ref}`: stopped — the agent's answer could not be used.
en.tracking.blocked.target_changed: Task `{ref}`: stopped — the pull request changed; ask again for the new version.
en.tracking.blocked.context_unavailable: Task `{ref}`: stopped — the pull request could not be read.
en.answer.incomplete: _Part of the context did not fit, so this answer is based on a partial view; it is not a complete review._
en.answer.aliased: _To change code, `fix` will be the command; it is not enabled yet._
en.approval.answer.title: Publish this answer on GitHub?
en.approval.review.title: Publish this comment review on GitHub?
en.approval.answer.message: Check the exact text and where it will be posted. The agent ran read-only; nothing else is changed.
en.approval.reply.title: Post this reply on GitHub?
en.approval.reply.message: A fixed reply to a command in the thread.
en.approval.tracking.title: Update the task's tracking comment on GitHub?
en.approval.tracking.message: A fixed status line for the task; it contains no command text.

zh-CN.manifest.name: GitHub 评论机器人
zh-CN.manifest.description: 在 GitHub Issue 与拉取请求评论中响应白名单协作者的 @ 指令，由只读智能体回答问题、发表评论式评审，并支持状态查询、取消与帮助。
zh-CN.reply.help:
**指令**（以提及开头另起一行；每条评论一个指令）：

```
{trigger} ask <问题>      回答关于此 Issue 或拉取请求的问题
{trigger} review [重点]   评审此拉取请求（仅评论）
{trigger} status [任务]   查看本线程的任务
{trigger} cancel [任务]   取消最近一个或指定的任务
{trigger} help            显示此帮助
```

提及之后没有指令的文字按 `ask` 处理。只有白名单中且有写权限的协作者可以使用这些指令。
zh-CN.reply.usage.multiple_commands: 这条评论包含多个指令。请每条评论只写一个指令。
zh-CN.reply.usage.reserved_verb: `{verb}` 不是本机器人会做的事。
zh-CN.reply.usage.too_large: 指令超过 {maxKiB} KiB，请拆成更小的请求。
zh-CN.reply.usage.bad_task_ref: 任务用 8 个字符的编号指定，例如 `0a1b2c3d`。
zh-CN.reply.usage.review_on_issue: `review` 只用于拉取请求。在 Issue 上请使用 `ask`。
zh-CN.reply.notEnabled: `{verb}` 尚未启用。请使用 `ask` 或 `review`。
zh-CN.reply.expired: 这条指令已超过 {hours} 小时，没有执行。如需执行请重新发布。
zh-CN.reply.cancelNothing: 本线程没有可取消的任务。
zh-CN.tracking.waiting: 任务 `{ref}`：回答已就绪，等待发布。
zh-CN.tracking.failed: 任务 `{ref}`：失败。详情见 Cognia 主机。
zh-CN.tracking.blocked.pii_blocked: 任务 `{ref}`：已停止 — 请求中含有不能发送给模型的个人信息。
zh-CN.tracking.blocked.readonly_violation: 任务 `{ref}`：已停止 — 智能体试图修改文件，因此没有发布任何内容。
zh-CN.tracking.blocked.budget_exceeded: 任务 `{ref}`：已停止 — 达到了本任务的费用上限。
zh-CN.tracking.blocked.recovery_required: 任务 `{ref}`：已停止 — 智能体会话中断，需要在 Cognia 主机上检查。
zh-CN.tracking.blocked.invalid_result: 任务 `{ref}`：已停止 — 智能体的回答无法使用。
zh-CN.tracking.blocked.target_changed: 任务 `{ref}`：已停止 — 拉取请求已变化，请针对新版本重新提问。
zh-CN.tracking.blocked.context_unavailable: 任务 `{ref}`：已停止 — 无法读取拉取请求。
zh-CN.answer.incomplete: _部分上下文超出上限，此回答基于不完整的内容，不是完整评审。_
zh-CN.answer.aliased: _修改代码将使用 `fix` 指令，目前尚未启用。_
zh-CN.approval.answer.title: 要在 GitHub 上发布这条回答吗？
zh-CN.approval.review.title: 要在 GitHub 上发布这条评论式评审吗？
zh-CN.approval.answer.message: 请核对确切文本和发布位置。智能体以只读方式运行，不会修改其他内容。
zh-CN.approval.reply.title: 要在 GitHub 上发布这条回复吗？
zh-CN.approval.reply.message: 对线程中指令的固定回复。
zh-CN.approval.tracking.title: 要更新该任务在 GitHub 上的跟踪评论吗？
zh-CN.approval.tracking.message: 任务的固定状态行，不含指令内容。

bots.name: GitHub Comment Bot
bots.description: Answer allowlisted collaborators' @-mention commands in issue and pull request comments: ask questions and get read-only reviews, with status, cancel and help.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: The repository whose comments this Bot answers, as owner/repo.

trigger.title: Trigger mention
trigger.description: The mention that addresses the Bot, for example @my-bot. Leave empty on a GitHub App account to use the App's own name; a personal-token account must set it.

allowedAuthorIds.title: Allowed authors (GitHub user ids)
allowedAuthorIds.description: Numeric GitHub user ids that may command the Bot. Each must also have write access to the repository when the command is checked.

publicationMode.title: Publication mode
publicationMode.description: Automatic publishes answers under an explicit host policy grant; approval asks a person before every reply.

agentPreset.title: External agent
agentPreset.description: The external agent preset that answers. Its model lane is the installation's route.

model.title: Agent model
model.description: Only for an agent on its own login. Leave empty when the installation routes through a Cognia model.

commandMaxAgeHours.title: Command validity (hours)
commandMaxAgeHours.description: A command older than this is not executed.

pollIntervalMs.title: Polling interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.description: How often comments are polled when webhooks are not delivering.
